"The project proposal states the requirements as: The lunar outpost is required to develop and protect potential United States interests on the moon; to develop techniques in moon-based surveillance of the earth and Space, in communications relay, and in operations on the surface of the moon; to serve on a base for exploration of the moon, for further
exploration into space and for military operations on the moon if required;
and to support scientific investigations on the moon."
